clue.text: It is culpable to find fault with a pillar of the establishment

parts.note: to find fault with someone is to blame them
a worthy is a respected, prominent citizen, a pillar of the establishment

explanation.surface: A respected public figure is found to be at fault after all.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone culpable deserves censure for a wrong done.

clue.text: Girl finds number acceptable repeatedly

indicators.note: the pair of letters is given twice over

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral fifty
U means upper-class, hence socially acceptable

explanation.surface: A girl finds a number satisfactory again and again.
explanation.definitionFit: Lulu is a female first name.

clue.text: Detailed description of this animal

parts.note: de-tailed, without a tail, describes this breed of cat from the Isle of Man

explanation.definitionFit: A breed of cat from the Isle of Man that is born without a tail.

clue.text: Cry a little quietly

parts.note: wee means small or a little
p is piano, the musical term for quietly

explanation.surface: Someone sheds a few quiet tears.
explanation.definitionFit: To weep is to shed tears, to cry.

clue.text: Polish statue or Italian flower

parts.note: to rub is to polish
an icon is an image or sculpted figure

explanation.surface: Choosing between polishing a statue and an Italian bloom.
explanation.walkthrough: 'flower' means something that flows, a river, not a bloom.
explanation.definitionFit: The Rubicon is a river in northern Italy famously crossed by Caesar.

clue.text: One who issues invitations to a great number

explanation.definitionFit: Both a person who entertains guests and a multitude, as in a heavenly throng.

clue.text: It won't be felt straight away

definitions.text: It won't be felt straight away

parts.words: It won't be felt straight away
parts.note: describes a result that shows up only some time after its cause

explanation.definitionFit: A delayed result or consequence, such as a lingering effect of a drug.

clue.text: It's a mistake to kiss an old gun

parts.note: a blunder is a mistake
buss is an old word meaning to kiss

explanation.surface: Kissing an antique firearm is a foolish thing to do.
explanation.definitionFit: A short, wide-muzzled firearm of the 17th and 18th centuries.

clue.text: The whole outfit of a conjuror?

definitions.text: The whole outfit of a conjuror?

parts.words: The whole outfit of a conjuror?
parts.note: a magician's kit taken literally, and also an idiom for every resource one has

explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for all one's resources, taken literally as a magician's kit of illusions.

clue.text: Confident of one's own worth despite revolutionary leader's fuss

indicators.note: a revolution turns things over, so the letters of leader's fuss are rearranged

explanation.surface: A revolutionary leader remains confident despite all the fuss.
explanation.walkthrough: The 's of 'leader's' supplies an S here, so all eleven letters of 'leader's fuss' are the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Self-assured means confident in one's own abilities.

clue.text: Formal statement at the end of an innings

definitions.text: at the end of an innings
definitions.meaning: in cricket a captain may close the batting side's innings early

explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, the batting captain may end the innings voluntarily; this is called declaring.
explanation.definitionFit: Both an official pronouncement and a cricket captain's decision to close an innings before all batsmen are out.

clue.text: Foreign lady's unending deceit

indicators.note: without an ending, so the final letter of the word for deceit is dropped

parts.note: fraud is deceit

explanation.surface: A woman from abroad is accused of endless trickery.
explanation.definitionFit: German for a married woman or wife, used as a title like Mrs.

clue.text: On the way back encountered orientalriver

indicators.note: travelling back, so the word for encountered is read backwards

parts.note: met means encountered
E for east, the orient

explanation.surface: Someone returning meets a river in the Orient.
explanation.walkthrough: 'On the way back' turns MET into TEM; E for oriental (eastern) follows. The held text runs 'oriental' and 'river' together.
explanation.definitionFit: The Teme is a river of the Welsh borders, a tributary of the Severn.

clue.text: Nothing in ruined chapel of a particular time

indicators.note: the round letter for nothing goes inside the rearranged letters
a ruined building is broken apart, so the letters of chapel are rearranged

parts.note: O, a zero, is nothing

explanation.surface: Nothing remains inside a ruined chapel from a bygone era.
explanation.walkthrough: 'ruined' turns CHAPEL into EPCHAL, and 'in' puts O inside it after EP.
explanation.definitionFit: Epochal means relating to an epoch, a distinctive period of history.

clue.text: It is included in a song for ordinary people

indicators.note: the word it goes inside the word for a song

parts.note: a lay is a song or ballad

explanation.surface: A ballad written for ordinary folk.
explanation.definitionFit: The laity are lay people, as distinct from the clergy.

clue.text: Miserable portion-and not quite complete

parts.note: to dole out is to give portions; a dole is a share

indicators.note: falling just short, so the last letter of the word for complete is lost

parts.note: full means complete

explanation.surface: Someone is unhappy that their share falls just short of the full amount.
explanation.definitionFit: Doleful means sorrowful, mournful.

clue.text: The prescribed amounts

parts.note: the quantities of medicine a doctor orders to be taken

explanation.definitionFit: Measured quantities of medicine taken at one time.

clue.text: In fact a long claw

indicators.note: the letters sit inside the run of words fact a long

explanation.surface: A remark that something really is a long claw.
explanation.definitionFit: A talon is the claw of a bird of prey.

clue.text: Swimmers have small feet going in two directions

indicators.note: the abbreviation for feet goes inside the two compass points

parts.note: E and S, east and south, are two compass directions
ft is the short form of feet

explanation.surface: Swimmers with little feet head off two ways at once.
explanation.definitionFit: Efts are young newts, which swim in ponds.

clue.text: Sure is adaptable for the consumer

indicators.note: something adaptable can be rearranged, so the letters of sure are reordered

explanation.surface: An advertising claim that a product suits every consumer.
explanation.definitionFit: A user is one who consumes or makes use of something.

clue.text: Neat guide

definitions.meaning: neat is an old word for cattle; a castrated young ox is a bullock
to direct the course of, as with a wheel

explanation.walkthrough: 'Neat' looks like tidy, but it is the old word for cattle.
explanation.definitionFit: A bullock is an old sense of neat (cattle), and to guide is to direct a vehicle.

clue.text: Boy about to tip out the cheese

indicators.note: the word for boy goes around the word for tip

parts.note: a son is a boy
to tilt is to tip

explanation.surface: A boy is about to empty the cheese onto the table.
explanation.definitionFit: Stilton is a strong English blue cheese.

clue.text: Harboured bitterness for a private soldier, say

indicators.note: say signals that the word for a private soldier is spoken

parts.note: a ranker is a soldier in the ranks

explanation.surface: A private soldier harbours bitterness.
explanation.definitionFit: Rancour is deep-seated resentment or ill will.

clue.text: Acting on impulse, journey by aeroplane to capital of Yemen

parts.note: a flight is a journey by air

indicators.note: the capital, or first letter, of the word Yemen

explanation.surface: Someone impulsively flies off to the capital of Yemen.
explanation.definitionFit: Flighty describes a fickle, capricious person who acts on whims.

clue.text: Extremely fine wood

parts.note: read as top-quality timber, but it means wood ground into the finest particles

explanation.definitionFit: The fine powder of wood produced by sawing.

clue.text: Edible soap?

parts.note: soap comes in bars of a certain name that also names a baked sweet food

explanation.definitionFit: Soap is sold by the bar, called a block of soap; the same word names a sweet baked food.

clue.text: We 're tossed into jug

indicators.note: things tossed are thrown about, so the letters of we're are mixed

explanation.surface: We are thrown into a jug.
explanation.definitionFit: A ewer is a large jug with a wide mouth.

clue.text: I leave the first cook

indicators.note: the letter I departs from the word for the first or foremost

parts.note: chief means principal, first in importance

explanation.surface: I hand over to the head cook.
explanation.definitionFit: A chef is a professional cook.

clue.text: Initially part exchange some other currency

indicators.note: the initial letters of the four words that follow

explanation.surface: A suggestion to trade some money in part exchange for another currency.
explanation.definitionFit: The peso is the monetary unit of Mexico and several other countries.

clue.text: Girl shortly from Peru

indicators.note: the girl's name is made from the letters of Peru, rearranged

explanation.surface: A girl comes from Peru.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Girl shortly' is a pet form of Prudence; 'from' signals the letters of PERU rearranged.
explanation.definitionFit: A short form of the name Prudence.

clue.text: Transfer directors at the exchange

parts.note: to switch is to transfer or swap
the board is the body of directors of a company

explanation.surface: Moving company directors to a post at the stock exchange.
explanation.definitionFit: A telephone exchange connects calls through a switchboard.

clue.text: Went through class with hesitation to make electrical apparatus

parts.note: trans- is the Latin prefix meaning across or through, as in transit
a form is a school class
er is a sound of hesitation

explanation.surface: Someone passed through school hesitantly to build electrical gear.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Went through' stands loosely for TRANS, the across-or-through prefix of transit; it is the weakest piece of the clue.
explanation.definitionFit: A device changing the voltage of an alternating current.
